source.title: Item matchup guide
source.author: an Eternus 6 (E6) Deadlock player
source.note: A cleaned-up transcription of the guide's recommendations, not an independent in-game test of every interaction. Adapt to enemy builds, team composition and what your teammates have already bought.

principles: Counter-items are valuable because they disrupt an enemy's game plan, keep you alive and let you keep contributing damage.
Don't blindly prioritise damage. If a defensive or utility item stops you being disabled or killed, it can be worth more than another damage purchase.
Consider your team's composition and avoid overlap. Carries should make sure they can protect themselves; teammates can cover the extra utility counters.
Indomitable is generally useful in a 1v1 against a hero whose crowd control triggers it, unless a matchup note says otherwise. Unstoppable is a strong alternative, especially against several threats.
Timing matters. Some counters must be activated before an ability lands; others cleanse an effect after it has been applied.

Debuff Remover.label: Debuff Remover
Debuff Remover.note: Named this way in the guide. The current item list has Debuff Reducer, not Debuff Remover, so check which effect is meant.

Anvil.label: Anvil
Anvil.note: Mentioned in the guide but not found in the current item list.

Parry.label: Parry
Parry.note: A melee mechanic, not an item.

Abrams.why: Reduce his ability to sustain himself and punish his large health pool.
Helps evade his charge or slam engagement.
Don't rely on Indomitable to stop his charge sequence: the charge's initial stun and the separate stun from hitting a wall are distinct interactions.

Apollo.why: Strongly limits his kit; the guide describes it as shutting down three of his four abilities.
If he has Debuff Remover, consider a second Slowing Hex from a teammate, or Silence Wave.

Bebop.why: Useful if you need to escape after being hooked.
Can break line of sight and avoid follow-up damage.
Counter his bomb setup, depending on the timing and the effect you're dealing with.

Billy.why: Can interrupt Rising Ram and limit his escape.
Options for dealing with his ultimate.

Calico.why: Restrict her mobility and ability usage.
Useful against her mobility-based game plan.

Celeste.why: Helps stop her escaping and can ground her.

The Doorman.why: Don't buy Slowing Hex to stop the door: it doesn't work, because the door isn't treated as a movement ability.
Silence Wave or other crowd control can disrupt his ability usage.
Options for dealing with his ultimate and escaping its effects.

Drifter.why: Use immediately when marked to remove the debuff and prevent the Toxic Bullets interaction.
Helps against his gun damage and stacks, but doesn't remove the debuff or its procs.

Dynamo.why: Options for surviving or escaping his ultimate.
Can pull an ally out of his ultimate.
Not the answer to his ultimate; the guide specifically warns it doesn't work for this interaction.

Graves.why: Useful against the skulls and ghouls.
Removes the wall-related debuff and Toxic Bullets effects.
Can destroy skulls with the right timing.

Grey Talon.why: Useful later against his spirit damage.

Haze.why: A strong defensive option against her crowd control.
Stops her building up stacks through sustained gunfire.
Temporary protection from gun damage, but doesn't remove stacks already applied.
Cursed Relic can remove Metal Skin, so don't assume Metal Skin's active protection is guaranteed to last.

Holliday.why: Triggers when Spirit Lasso hits you and grants a barrier. It doesn't stop the lasso connecting; the first lasso damage can land before the barrier.
Alternatives if you can react to the lasso in time.
Useful against her gun damage. The lasso can also give her a shield in a 1v1.

Infernus.why: High priority for removing his burn.
Help against his damage and buildup.

Ivy.why: Against High Docker's gun Ivy build (High Docker is a player/creator — this means that specific build).
Against the other Ivy build: recommended against Stone Form.

Kelvin.why: Use before Path activates to prevent or limit the escape.
Can knock an airborne Kelvin through Path.
Helps against the healing from his dome.
Can help you survive inside the dome.

Lady Geist.why: Particularly useful against her low-health playstyle.
Limit her ability to use her kit.
Against a late-game, gun-focused Lady Geist.

Lash.why: Particularly strong: can nullify the damage from his slam.
Other options for dealing with his ultimate.
Another option mentioned in the guide.

McGinnis.why: Make her turrets easier to kill; both affect summons and turrets.
Bring several knockdowns or stuns: her Indomitable can absorb the first crowd control, so one disable may not be enough.

Mina.why: Can be removed by Debuff Remover; coordinate with a teammate to reapply it if needed.
Not very effective because of the timing window her bat ability creates.

Mirage.why: Removes the beetle effect, damage reduction, marks and tornado lift.
Recommended against the Quad Tornado build.
Can help, but may need two applications if he has Debuff Remover.

Mo & Krill.why: Difficult to time, but potentially very effective.
Options for dealing with their crowd control.
Reduces the impact of their ultimate.

Paige.why: Removes her knockdown and root effects.
An alternative for dealing with her crowd control.
She can cleanse it with Dispel Magic, so don't rely on it as a guaranteed disable.

Paradox.why: Useful against her ultimate specifically. Carbine does not trigger it.

Pocket.why: Stops him taking his cloak, but not throwing it.

Rem.why: Removes her telegraphed stun and Toxic Bullets effects.
An ally can use it against her ultimate.

Seven.why: Removes his stun and Toxic Bullets effects.
An ally can use it against his ultimate.
Forces him to account for you ignoring his crowd control.

Shiv.why: Reduces his burst damage and how long its effects last.

Silver.why: Useful against his human-form gun damage.
Stops him chasing with his dash.

Sinclair.why: Can be useful depending on the ultimate interaction.

Victor.why: Blocks his gun damage and ultimate.
Stops him shooting while it lasts.

Vindicta.why: Limits her ability to fly away.
Another way to engage and catch her.
Buying these counters can force her to spend on Debuff Remover, Counterspell or Unstoppable.

Viscous.why: A successful parry gives a 30% damage-amplification window.

Vyper.why: Mitigate or interrupt her gun pressure.

Warden.why: Options for dealing with his cage.

Wraith.why: Use after the ultimate connects to escape the effect.

Yamato.why: Removes the debuff from her second ability.
Can stop her activating her ultimate.
